notes.title: Knowledge Domination Officially Launches on January 3, 2025
notes.notes:
Hello to everyone eagerly awaiting our game!

Heads Up!
The general knowledge-themed region conquest game Knowledge Domination will officially be released on January 3, 2025. Get ready for endless fun with your friends!

We want to keep developing our game together with you, so join our Discord community at https://discord.com/invite/UbYA3Tg9JG You can find new gaming buddies and share your ideas directly with the development team.

See you on January 3, 2025! 👋
Best regards,
